stories.title: Police close Flintshire Bridge both ways due to A548 incident in Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: The Flintshire Bridge is closed in both directions because of an incident on the A548 in Connah’s Quay, police have said. North Wales Police’s North Flintshire team said officers were at the scene on Friday afternoon. The team said: Please avoid the area for the time being and take alternative routes where possible. No details

stories.title: Rocks thrown at houses and passing cars, Penyffordd councillor says
stories.summary: Rocks were thrown at houses, parked cars and passing traffic on Chester Road in Penyffordd, a local councillor has said. stories.title: Shotton Mill director joins new business board advising on North Wales economy
stories.summary: Jackie Pearson is one of nine members of Ambition North Wales' Business Advisory Board, which will advise on the Growth Deal and the Flintshire and Wrexham Investment Zone.
